title: Email template locale ladder: three texts outside packages/spec still say the resolver matches exactly with no language-subtag folding (stale since #28880)
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmPi25XXKx92Xmg4viS

Filing gate: ① the follow-up of #28896, named by its dev in `handoff_slices` (os-dev-report 6570414192) and kept out of PR #29014 because they are outside the spec lane's surface. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

Reach: authors and QA runs that read these texts. They are told `zh` never resolves `zh-CN` and `en` never resolves `en-US`. Since #28880 (PR #28917, `e0dc0771ab`), over the built-in template loader, a call that names a locale folds it against the bundle's tags (`resolveBundleLocale`: exact, case-insensitive, base language, variant expansion), then tries the stack's declared fallback locale folded the same way, then `en-US`, then `TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND`. A replacement `TemplateLoader` keeps the exact ladder. A call that names no locale keeps `en-US` → lowest tag.

## Where (on `main`)

1. `content/docs/automation/email-templates.mdx` L217–233: a hand-written page that restates the exact ladder. Reader: `domain:devx`.
2. `packages/metadata-core/src/item-key-discriminators.ts` L13–19: the docblock cites the old exact ladder. Reader: the owner of `packages/metadata-core`.
3. `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/integration-system.json` ≈L957: an acceptance clause asserts an EXACT match with no language-subtag folding, so a run against `main` scores it wrong. Reader: the checklist owner. Bump the item's revision with a history entry.

## Done when

All three describe the ladder as `SendTemplateInput.locale` in `packages/spec/src/contracts/email-service.ts` states it once PR #29014 lands. Copy that text; don't restate it independently. `en` and `en-US` stay two rows of one bundle.

Blocked-by: #28896 (PR #29014 carries the spec wording these copy).
Dedupe: searched `email template locale exact ladder folding`; only #28880, #28896. **New.**
